• Staff cancel paid orders, or some of their dishes, on Orders awaiting payment › Paid orders (19f); the kitchen
display no longer has Cancel order (panel feedback). Any signed-in Staff or Admin can do it, until the kitchen
• Chosen dishes still not started go back into stock, logged as a customer return under the person who cancelled;
a dish started or done counts as used. The returns show in Stock movements (14g).
• The system can't send money back, so the refund happens outside it (cash from the drawer, or GCash / Maya back
to the customer), and staff record it. A late or repeated online payment event can't undo a refund. Each cancel
adds its own line to the order's note, so every amount owed stays on screen.
